records.text: Candace Owens alleged that Paramount Tactical Solutions and Valhalla VFT pressured Mitch Snow to turn against her while Ian Carroll pressured Owens to disavow Snow, so each would believe the other was a fraud.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: you had this paramount tactical account in Valhalla who called up Mitch (Mitch Snow). ... At the exact same time, they had Ian Carroll calling me, and Ian Carroll was being a friend, and he's like, hey, you should get on the phone with them, and you should come out against Mitch, because Mitch is a fraud ... So just to make that clear, they're trying to pressure Mitch (Mitch Snow) to say something against me and trying to pressure me to say something against Mitch (Mitch Snow) to believe that Mitch (Mitch Snow) was a fraud and to have Mitch (Mitch Snow) believe that I was a fraud.

verification.notes: Transcript context and a current transcript mirror establish that Candace Owens made this accusation. Live searches also found Paramount Tactical's public countercharacterization that Ian Carroll and Valhalla VFT warned Owens that Mitch Snow lied, rather than pressured her or coordinated a scheme. No authenticated call recordings, complete messages, or independent witness evidence were found that establish pressure on Snow, pressure on Owens, or the alleged purpose of making each distrust the other. The underlying private interactions therefore remain unverifiable; the public rebuttal is not direct proof that the accusation is false.
